commit.message: governance: admit mission control organism integration

intent: Durably admit the exact additive Mission Control, governed-dispatch, A2A, Apex Sarathi, immutable read-model, API projection, dashboard, and Operator Brief citation surfaces before implementation. Declare a non-coercible authority ladder from proposal through merge, explicitly cap every admitted edge at recorded evidence rather than executor liveness, and preserve TaskBoard, RuntimeStateStore, A2A, Forge, and Merge Master ownership boundaries.

honest_blockers: Admission and later code wiring do not start a Sarathi process, Mission Control MCP, API server, A2A consumer, NATS topology, or fleet supervisor.
The current self-hashed execution lease is not authenticated authority for higher-risk dispatch; the backend slice must require an injected authenticity verifier.
A2A publish and consume acknowledgements are transport evidence, not semantic outcome, promotion, merge, or process-liveness proof.
The first operator projection requires an explicit mission_id and intentionally performs no unbounded mission discovery.
Forge remains the sole promotion arbiter and Merge Master Mike remains the sole conditional merge authority.
interface_mismatches: Mission Control has no list_missions API; the read-only operator vertical must use explicit mission identity and immutable SQLite snapshots.
A2A owns its native lifecycle and receipts, so wrapping A2A dispatch in MissionControl start, heartbeat, or finish would duplicate authority and state.
Sarathi PlannedDelegation dependencies are proposal-local labels, not Mission Control task IDs; an explicit complete dependency mapping is required.
The existing control-surface router is already mounted; the operator vertical should extend that GET-only surface instead of editing sibling-owned api/main.py.
Legacy Sarathi wake and mailbox artifacts are private projections and cannot be promoted into canonical Mission Control truth.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the governance admission commit. No runtime, transport, database, API, dashboard, daemon, or external state is changed by this packet.
